title: ReplacementAssignment
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.1. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.casework.ReplacementAssignment). Closes the capability gap a blocking recusal opens. The replacement is itself checked against the case's recusal records, so a matter cannot be 'resolved' by handing it to somebody equally conflicted. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
